# Upstream plugin table tests (crates/server/tests/plugin_cases).
#
# <status> <plugin> <table>[#row] <reason>
#   skip:  the table (or row) is not run, with the reason
#   xfail: the row fails today, with the reason; a passing xfail fails
#          the test, so it gets removed from here
#
# Tables are named Func/var, or var at package level; rows are #index
# (or #key for maps, #row.sub for nested tables). Tables that could not be
# evaluated outside their test function are listed in the fixture with
# the compiler's message and reported by the test, not here.

# file
skip file miekAuth records shared by other tables (checked through them)
skip file auth records shared by other tables (checked through them)
skip file additionalAuth records shared by other tables (checked through them)
skip file svcbAuth records shared by other tables (checked through them)
skip file dnssexAuth records shared by other tables (checked through them)
skip file exampleAuth records shared by other tables (checked through them)
skip file TestClosestEncloser/tests tests the Go Zone.ClosestEncloser method directly
skip file TestCanonicalEscape/cases tests the Go canonicalEscape helper
skip file TestReplaceWithAsteriskLabel/tests tests the Go replaceWithAsteriskLabel helper
skip file TestNameFromRight/tests tests the Go Zone.nameFromRight helper
skip file TestZoneReloadByMtime/expectedNS rewrites the zone file mid-test and waits for the reload ticker; not a query table

# hosts
skip hosts TestReplaceWithAsteriskLabel/tests tests the Go replaceWithAsteriskLabel helper
